```{r}
library(caret)
library(tidyverse)

# 1. LOAD DATA
final_engineered_data <- read_csv("../data/final_engineered_data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# 2. INITIAL CLEANING & FILTERING
data_clean <- final_engineered_data %>%
  slice(-(1:288)) %>%
  filter(HVAC_off == TRUE) %>%
  # Remove raw categorical columns that shouldn't be dummied
  select(-any_of(c("HvacMode", "HVAC_off", "Wind_Direction", "season")), 
         -starts_with("T_stp"), -starts_with("Event")) %>%
  mutate(across(any_of(c("is_weekend", "is_holiday")), as.numeric)) %>%
  drop_na() 

# 3. CREATE DUMMY VARIABLES
dummies <- dummyVars(Thermostat_Temperature ~ . - DateTime, data = data_clean)
data_dummies <- as.data.frame(predict(dummies, newdata = data_clean))
data_dummies$Thermostat_Temperature <- data_clean$Thermostat_Temperature
data_dummies$DateTime <- data_clean$DateTime

# 4. ZERO AND NEAR-ZERO VARIANCE
nzv <- nearZeroVar(data_dummies %>% select(-DateTime), saveMetrics = TRUE)
keep_cols <- rownames(nzv[nzv$nzv == FALSE, ])
data_nzv_filtered <- data_dummies[, c(keep_cols, "DateTime")]

# 5. IDENTIFY CORRELATED PREDICTORS (Cutoff 0.90)
data_for_cor <- data_nzv_filtered %>% select(-DateTime, -Thermostat_Temperature)
descrCor <- cor(data_for_cor)
highlyCorDescr <- findCorrelation(descrCor, cutoff = .90)
data_cor_filtered <- data_nzv_filtered %>% select(-all_of(colnames(data_for_cor)[highlyCorDescr]))

# 6. LINEAR DEPENDENCIES
data_for_combos <- data_cor_filtered %>% select(-DateTime) %>% select(where(~ var(.) > 0)) 
comboInfo <- findLinearCombos(data_for_combos)

if(!is.null(comboInfo$remove)) {
  final_preprocessed_data <- data_cor_filtered %>% select(-colnames(data_for_combos)[comboInfo$remove])
} else {
  final_preprocessed_data <- data_cor_filtered
}

# 7. FINAL PRUNE (The "Scorched Earth" Step)
# This removes ScheduleSleep even if dummyVars recreated it
final_preprocessed_data <- final_preprocessed_data %>%
  select(-any_of("ScheduleSleep"))

# 8. SAVE FINAL DATA
write_csv(final_preprocessed_data, "../data/final_preprocessed_data.csv")
cat("\n[05] Pre-processing complete. 'ScheduleSleep' confirmed removed.\n")
```

  group_by(Model) %>%
  summarise(
    Avg_RMSE = mean(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_RMSE = sd(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_runs = n()
  ) %>%
  arrange(Avg_RMSE)

print(summary_partial)

  final_imp <- bind_rows(lm_importance_list) %>%
    group_by(Feature) %>%
    summarise(Avg_Importance = mean(Importance, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(desc(Avg_Importance))
  
  print(head(final_imp))
